//products: Each watched Amazon.in product: asin, a short name for pushes, and storePage, the brand's Amazon store page whose HTML embeds the product's record ("asin":"<asin>","buyingOptions"). Not the /dp/ product page: while the Clara BW has no offer, Amazon serves its SleepCover there. Products on the same storePage share one fetch. Run --dump to see every record on a store page.
//notify: Your ntfy topic is SECRET (it is the only password on free ntfy.sh) -> set NTFY_TOPIC in the .env file, NOT here. Optionally override the server with NTFY_SERVER.

notify.//remindEveryMinutes: While a watched product stays in stock, push a high-priority reminder at most this often.
notify.//dailyHour: Send one quiet (min priority) check-in push per day at/after this hour (local time; set TZ in docker-compose). It is the proof-of-life heartbeat. -1 disables.
notify.//failureAlertHours: If every check fails for this long, push one warning (reset on the next good check).

//watch: After each check the tracker writes next-run (unix seconds) = now + intervalMinutes +/- jitterSeconds, and run-loop.sh sleeps until then. The Clara BW sells in small batches; one check is one ~120 KB page (gzipped on the wire), so 5 minutes is still polite.
